name: builtin-docker-repair
description: Build and run each repaired image; verify stdout or HTTP behavior and layer ordering. Requires a working Docker daemon and registry access.

cases.prompt: Fix the broken base image to node:22-slim and preserve a container that prints ok when run. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-sllm
WORKDIR /app
COPY src/ ./src/
CMD ["node","src/index.js"]

cases.prompt: Fix the missing Docker startup command so the existing src/server.js serves hello on port 3000. Build and run the image to verify its HTTP response. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

Reorder the Dockerfile so package.json and package-lock.json are copied and npm ci runs before copying src/. Preserve the executable image and exact dependencies. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY src/ ./src/
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci --ignore-scripts
CMD ["node","src/index.js"]
